description: Get the event's review rounds and how far reviewers have got. Use it to answer how reviewing is going or which rounds still need decisions. Returns rounds[] with roundId, name, status, total assignments, completed, completionPercent, and pendingDecisions (null where results are hidden from you), plus truncated.

eventId.description: Event id, as returned by list_events.

org.description: Organization slug from list_my_orgs; only needed if you belong to several.

name: get_review_progress

completed.description: Completed reviews, or null when hidden.

completionPercent.description: Percent complete, or null when hidden.

pendingDecisions.description: Reviews not yet done, or null when hidden.

truncated.description: True when more rows exist than were returned (a cap was reached).
